answer: One concrete Sybil defense is economic stake: each agent identity must lock collateral before it may earn rewards or cast votes. Picture three traders, cedar, terrace, and quartz, each posting a bond into a common vault. A single fake identity is cheap, but a thousand demand a thousand separate bonds, so the cost to the attacker rises in step with any influence gained. Detected fraud slashes the bond, so the capital is forfeited rather than recycled.
